author: Black Forest Labs
name: FLUX.1 schnell

notes: Weights are downloaded at full precision and quantized one component at a time, so loading peaks at 26.6 GB whatever precision was asked for. Saving a quantized copy removes that spike.

This estimate is extrapolated. The memory model was fitted to measured FLUX.2 klein runs; nothing in this model's family has been measured against it, so treat the figure as an order of magnitude rather than a number.
